verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Airwallex serves an llms.txt file at its root domain (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The visible excerpt is a company overview rather than developer-doc navigation, and the probe for a markdown docs variant (docs.md) returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers the API/developer docs rather than marketing content, markdown or agent-oriented versions of the docs, first-party documentation of the llms.txt offering, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.airwallex.com/llms.txt # Airwallex
